title: Policies & Terms
subtitle: Protecting customer interests and ensuring complete peace of mind for audiophiles
contactSupport: Questions about our policies? Contact Hotline / Zalo at 0931 772 150 for direct assistance.

shipping.title: Shipping Fees & Delivery
shipping.content: We operate online. Shipping fees and delivery timing are confirmed for your items and delivery address.

details.heading: 1. Shipping fees
details.text: Product prices exclude delivery. Send your address to receive a quote; shipping fees are confirmed with you before dispatch.

details.heading: 2. Delivery timing
details.text: Dispatch and estimated arrival depend on your address, stock and carrier. The store discusses the schedule when confirming your order; there is no blanket delivery-time guarantee.

details.heading: 3. Packaging and receipt
details.text: Discuss packaging and parcel inspection before dispatch. Check the packaging on arrival, keep photos/videos of any issues and contact us with your order code.

warranty.title: Warranty Information
warranty.content: There is no default warranty period covering every vacuum tube and component.

details.heading: 1. Confirm before purchase
details.text: Ask the store to confirm the warranty period, coverage and conditions for the exact product, option and condition. Only terms confirmed in the product information or order discussion apply.

details.heading: 2. Request assistance
details.text: Send the order code, product name, issue description and relevant photos/videos via Zalo or the contact form. The store will review the information and discuss a solution.

details.heading: 3. Before returning an item
details.text: Confirm the return address, packaging and any shipping costs with the store before sending anything back.

returns.title: Returns Information
returns.content: Return conditions depend on the product and the terms confirmed with the store.

details.heading: 1. Conditions and time limits
details.text: Before buying, confirm eligible cases, notice periods, item condition requirements and shipping costs. The website does not apply an automatic 7- or 14-day window to every item.

details.heading: 2. Report an order issue
details.text: For wrong, missing or possibly damaged items, retain the packaging and contact us with the order code and photos/videos. Agree on the next step before sending anything back.

details.heading: 3. Agreed refunds
details.text: If a return is agreed, the store confirms the amount, payment method and processing time. No automatic refund within a fixed time is promised.

payment.title: Payment & Order Confirmation
payment.content: Choose an available checkout method and confirm your order details with the store.

details.heading: 1. Item prices and delivery
details.text: Item totals follow the selected products, options and quantities. Shipping is excluded and must be confirmed for your address.

details.heading: 2. Payment methods
details.text: Checkout shows the methods available for your order, including COD or bank transfer where available. Check the account details and order code in the transfer instructions; payments need verification by the store.

details.heading: 3. Deposits where available
details.text: Use deposits only for eligible products and orders. Check the amount, deadline and reservation period and confirm cancellation/refund conditions before paying. No default deposit percentage or reservation period applies to all items.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Contact information is used to support requests and process orders.

details.heading: 1. Data Collection
details.text: We only collect your name, phone number, shipping address, and email to fulfill orders, manage warranties, and provide status notifications.

details.heading: 2. No Third-Party Sharing
details.text: We strictly guarantee never to sell, trade, or share your data with third parties, except the courier handling your physical parcel.

details.heading: 3. Data Rights
details.text: You may request account data updates or deletions at any time by contacting our hotline or emailing thientan.3003.01@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: Terms and conditions governing purchases and interactions at Vintage Audio Accessories.

details.heading: 1. Product Authenticity
details.text: Review the information and images for the exact product, option, selling unit and condition. Contact the store if you need clarification before purchase.

details.heading: 2. Order Confirmation
details.text: After receiving an order, the store confirms availability, recipient details, delivery fees and timing before dispatch.

details.heading: 3. Intellectual Property
details.text: All articles, guides, photography, and demonstration videos are copyrighted property of Vintage Audio Accessories.
